decisions.reason: The date-selector scope expansion does not change placeholder-clearing behavior; the same message already contains separate, independently annotated placeholder evidence.
Extending the reusable date selector to additional templates does not change the independently specified checklist control.
The dropdown control already applies in Bestyrelsesmode, and the source does not change its control type, behavior, or scope.
The source expands date-selector availability but does not change how fillable fields are visually identified.
Date-selector reuse does not alter the required mechanism for ordinary text placeholders.
Help labels already apply to all control fields and already define the date-field text, so adding date-selector contexts requires no state change.
Multiline text-entry behavior is independently introduced by another clause in the source and is not changed by the date-selector scope expansion.
The date-selector scope change does not modify title-field formatting preservation.
Date-selector reuse has no necessary effect on automatic list continuation when Enter is pressed.
Board Meeting field alignment is independently established by another clause and is unaffected by adding the reusable date selector.
The date-selector scope expansion does not change line insertion or border behavior in Board Meeting rows.
Continuous-text line spacing is independently established by another clause and is not affected by date-selector availability.
